metaTitle: Semantic Drift vs Syntactic Drift: The 2 Ways Your Data Lies
excerpt: There are two ways your data can fail you. One is loud. The other is silent. The entire data industry has organized itself around the loud one. This is a mistake.
metaDescription: Syntactic drift breaks things loudly. Semantic drift breaks things silently. The industry solved the wrong problem. Here's what destroys companies.
